items.text: SWE-Bench Pro is contaminated — models regularly cheat, Chinese model scores aren't real, the leaderboard has been nonsense

Nvidia RTX Spark: first re-engineered PC in 40 years, MCP server built in, Adobe rebuilt Photoshop and Premiere 2x faster for it
PBS thermal drone over Stargate: 4M sq ft, 1,100 acres, heat signatures at sites that denied violations — $7T by 2030
Uber burned annual AI budget in 4 months: engineers $500-$2,000/month on top of salary, leaderboard rewarded spending
Ed Zitron: tokenmaxxing era ending — Uber COO can't justify budget, Anthropic revenue will burst and contract violently
$725B capex 2026: Zuckerberg said 'more infrastructure = less capital for people' — layoffs are capital allocation not AI replacement
Hormozi (21M followers): entertainers low AI risk, information providers high risk — lived experience is what's actually protected

Forward Deployed Engineers: OpenAI 30/70 open roles are FDE consultants — AI replaces engineers, AI rehires engineers, different title
